meta.reset: Reset DB, cache and search index to `fixtures` before every case. Seed fixtures.languages first, then fixtures.categories: one object per translation (slug, hidden, navbar, lang, name). hidden and navbar are shared per slug, so every row of a slug repeats the same values; the loader should assert that rows of one slug agree. Cases tagged needs_bulk additionally seed fixtures.bulk (150 en categories); all other cases run without it. Actor rows are seeded by the harness; inject sessions directly.
meta.actor: Key into fixtures.actors, or: anonymous, garbage_session, expired_session. Actor caps are per entity: caps.categories = [create, edit, delete]; root holds everything for the cross-system cases. Listing, reading and searching need only a valid session.
meta.language: Body and response field is `lang`. POST/PATCH/search send a fallback language in the Content-Language header (used when body lang is empty, null or missing); GET routes send Accept-Language. DELETE needs neither. Search: the doc header table says Accept-Language but the body text says Content-Language; cases follow Content-Language and one case pins that Accept-Language is ignored (verify_doc_typo).
meta.request: path_params are unescaped and must be percent-encoded when substituted. headers: null removes a default header. A request with a body carries Content-Type: application/json unless overridden. body_generator {json_padded_bytes: N, base} = valid JSON of exactly N bytes, padded with an unknown field. body_raw (string) sends the exact bytes given, with no JSON encoding, for malformed or exotic bodies; it is used instead of body. Paths may carry a literal query string.
meta.json_assertions: ops used: type (incl. boolean), eq, len_eq, gte, includes, excludes, sorted_asc, sorted_desc. Paths with [*] resolve to lists; filter paths like $.categories[?(@.slug=='news')].name must match exactly one element. Each assertion is {path, op, value}; value is omitted for ops that need none.
meta.eventually_ms: Retry the step until it passes or the timeout elapses (search indexing is async).
meta.source: documented = rules inside the source_document; stated = rules you gave outside it (413, 415, 409, 401, name rules, null -> zero value); inferred = derived from conventions or from the users and language tests.
meta.null_handling: null decodes to the Go zero value. Cases accept it wherever the zero value is acceptable (name '', hidden/navbar false, empty query, count/page 0, empty sort_by, lang -> header fallback) and expect 400 where it is not (slug ''; lang '' with no header).
meta.name_rules: name is trimmed (surrounding whitespace and control characters), is at most 254 characters (counted in runes, after trimming; tagged verify_name_rules) and is valid unless it contains non-printable characters; the empty name is valid. Language names follow the same rules (inferred).
meta.tags: boundary, cache, security, regression, undocumented_limit, needs_bulk, cross_system (touches /cms/languages), verify_normalisation, verify_slug_rules (slug charset, hyphen rules, 128 cap), verify_name_rules, verify_printable (depends on the exact definition of printable, assumed unicode.IsPrint), verify_defaults (hidden/navbar default to false), verify_shared_flags (flags are per category, not per translation), verify_language_precedence (body lang vs Content-Language), verify_language_validation (lang must exist in the cms record), verify_content_language (how the fallback header is parsed), verify_accept_language (q-values, region subtags, wildcard, missing header on GET), verify_hidden_visibility (admin API returns hidden categories), verify_patch_new_translation (PATCH in a language with no translation creates one, even without a name), verify_patch_empty (effect of name '' on PATCH), verify_patch_create_perm (which capability creating a translation through PATCH needs), verify_patch_conflict (409 on slug rename), verify_noop, verify_cascade (category disappears with its last translation), verify_sortable (name and slug sortable; hidden, navbar, lang not), verify_clamp, verify_doc_typo (count defaults to 1), verify_reserved_slug (slug `search` vs the search route), verify_bodiless (Content-Type and size handling on GET/DELETE), verify_check_order. Extra tags: verify_unknown_fields (unknown JSON fields ignored), verify_strict_json (trailing data, BOM), verify_duplicate_keys (last key wins), verify_case_insensitive_keys (Go decoding), verify_content_type (charset parameter, case), verify_search_matching (substring/prefix, case, literal wildcards, no fuzzy), verify_empty_last_page (last_page for 0 results = 0), verify_iso_validation (language code must be a real ISO 639-1 code), verify_default_language_delete (deleting the fallback language), verify_method_routing (405/404 for odd methods and paths), verify_query_params (query strings ignored).
meta.slug_rules: slug: lowercase ASCII letters, '-' and '_' only; leading and trailing '-' and '_' are trimmed first, the result must be 1..128 chars. Digits, upper case, whitespace and non-ASCII are rejected with 400 (not normalised); tagged verify_slug_rules / verify_normalisation. The same normalisation applies to path slugs. Language code: exactly two lowercase letters that are a real ISO 639-1 code (verify_iso_validation).
meta.values: Any string value (body fields, path_params, headers, body_raw, assertion values) may be {"$repeat": {"s": char(s), "n": count}} for pure repetition, or {"$printf": {"format": "%s-%s", "values": [...]}} where every %s takes the next value (a string or another $repeat) for mixed strings.
meta.check_order: Assumed order of checks: 401 (session, then capability) -> 413 (size) -> 415 (Content-Type) -> 400 (body/params; language existence) -> 404 -> 409. Cases tagged verify_check_order pin this assumption.
meta.listing_semantics: Listing and search return only translations in the resolved language (no per-item fallback to the default language); hidden categories are included because this is the admin API.

fixtures._notes: en has 5 categories (apple, news, secret, sports, tech_news), ru has 2 (news, ru-only), de has 1 (sports). With bulk: en has 155. fixtures.bulk.categories is a row generator: it emits 150 rows starting from the given row and incrementing the two-letter base-26 suffix in both slug and name (bulk-aa/Bulk AA .. bulk-ft/Bulk FT; no digits, see slug rules). Sorted by slug they sit between 'apple' and 'news'.
